setting: You are all members of the same allotment society in a town in the UK, and you know each other through the society's plots, its committee and its monthly meetings.
openers: Sending a photo of the shed roof
Posting the agenda for Thursday's meeting
Reminding everyone about the subs deadline
opener: Reminding everyone about the subs deadline

Malcolm.knows: You chair the society and know Joanne as its treasurer, whose books you trust. You know Hannah as the secretary who keeps the minutes, and Ryan as a younger plot holder who has helped on work days. You have known Pauline for years as a plot holder who never misses a Saturday.
Malcolm.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked anything, mostly when there is a society matter to share.
Malcolm.style: Little emoji and few texting abbreviations.

Joanne.knows: You are the society's treasurer and you keep its accounts, which you share with Malcolm as chair. You know Hannah as the secretary who works with you on the minutes and the budget. You know Ryan as a plot holder who pays his subs on time, and Pauline as a long-standing plot holder you sometimes chat with after meetings.
Joanne.texts: You message the group mostly when there is money or a form to deal with, and otherwise only now and then.
Joanne.style: Little emoji and few texting abbreviations.

Hannah.knows: You are the society's secretary and you take the minutes at meetings, working closely with Malcolm and Joanne. You know Joanne as the treasurer who keeps the accounts in order. You know Ryan as a younger plot holder you have spoken with at work days, and Pauline as a plot holder who gives you advice on her beds.
Hannah.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, usually to remind people of a meeting or pass on a note.
Hannah.style: Little emoji and few texting abbreviations.

Ryan.knows: You are a plot holder who has been on the site for a few years, and you know Malcolm as the chair who signs off on the plot rules. You know Joanne as the treasurer who sends the subs reminders, and Hannah as the secretary who sends the meeting notes. You know Pauline as an older plot holder who swaps seedlings with you.
Ryan.texts: You message the group rarely, mostly when you have something for the plot or a question about the site.
Ryan.style: Some emoji and a few texting abbreviations.

Pauline.knows: You are a plot holder who has been on the site for many years, and you know Malcolm as the chair who keeps the site running. You know Joanne as the treasurer you talk to after meetings, and Hannah as the secretary who has become a friend. You know Ryan as a younger plot holder who is always willing to help with the heavy work.
Pauline.texts: You message the group now and then without being asked, mostly to share something about the plot or ask a quick question.
Pauline.style: Little emoji and few texting abbreviations.

private_lines.Malcolm: You are retired from a career as a land surveyor, and your days go to the plot, the shed, the paperwork for the society, and long walks with the dog. You live alone in a house a few streets from the allotments and keep a regular routine.
private_lines.Joanne: You work as a bookkeeper for a few local businesses, and your days are spent at your desk, on the plot in the evenings when you can, and with friends. You live alone in a flat in town and keep your weekends fairly quiet.
private_lines.Hannah: You teach at a primary school, and your days are spent on lessons, marking and school runs. You live alone in a small house near the school and grow vegetables on your plot at weekends.
private_lines.Ryan: You work as a sous chef at a restaurant in town, so your shifts often run late into the evening. You share a rented flat with no one, sleep late after shifts, and go to the plot on your days off when the weather is good.
private_lines.Pauline: You work part-time at a shop in town, and your days are spent between your shifts, your plot and time with your grandchildren. You live alone in a bungalow near the allotments and keep your days fairly steady.

text: Reminder, subs are due by the 30th. £60 for the year, same as last year. Pay Joanne direct or cash at Saturday's work day 👍
Put your plot number as the reference please, makes my life easier
Ok
Joanne can you confirm £60 before I put it in the newsletter? Don't want to get it wrong again
Confirmed, it's £60. Checked the minutes from last year 👍
Thanks Malcolm
Does anyone know if the standpipe gets turned off for winter? Bit of frost forecast tonight
Think it's the 1st of December. Malcolm?
£60 yes Hannah
Shut off 1st Dec as usual. I'll put a notice on the gate. Pauline, the leeks will be fine if you wrap them
Thank you Malcolm. I'll wrap them.
paid mine last week, sorry it's late on the list
No bother Ryan, got it
Paid by bank this morning
Thanks both. Newsletter goes Thursday then. Anyone with plot news send it to me by Weds
Will do
Hannah, are we still doing the budget meeting on the 4th or has it moved?
Still the 4th Joanne, 7pm at the hut
Thanks
anyone know if the gate code changed? still the old one?
Still the same one Ryan. Haven't changed it. I'll send it to you direct rather than put it in here
Joanne I'll read the draft accounts tonight if you send them over
Frost on all the cars already. Leeks are wrapped
Good. Should be a dry day
Sending the draft now Hannah. Two shed receipts missing from October, will chase
Plot news for the newsletter: someone has left a bag of spuds by the hut with no name on. Whoever it was, thank you, I've put them in the box for the food bank
Ta Pauline 👍
[photo: standpipe notice taped to the gate]
Put it up this morning. Water off from 1st Dec
Good, thank you
Got the two receipts. Hannah I've put the draft in the shared folder too
Got it, thanks. Will go through it tonight
Does the hut need anything for the 4th? I can bring biscuits
I'll sort biscuits, you're alright
Tea and coffee are in the cupboard already. Milk I'll get
found the code, it was the old one like Malcolm said. cheers all. shift's running late so I'll check the plot Sat
Accounts look fine to me Joanne. Just the two shed figures to check against the receipts
Morning. Anything to add to the agenda for the 4th? I'll put the insurance renewal on it
Quote came in last night. Will send it over after work. Shed figures I'm on it Hannah
Insurance going up again I suppose
Slightly. Not as bad as they said
[photo: frost on the shed roof]
Dog wasn't impressed
Hannah when you've a minute, is it too late to put garlic in? Bed three is still full of the beans
Garlic can go in up to Christmas Pauline. Pull the beans first though, they'll be fine in a bag somewhere cool
Ok, I'll do it Saturday. Thank you
Joanne which shed receipts are the 14th and 22nd? I've got 41.50 on the sheet for the 22nd but the receipt I've got says 38
14th is the paint, 22nd is hinges. Paint's 19.99 I think. Checking now
Paint's right. Hinges were 41.50 on the card, I wrote 38 from the other receipt. My mistake. Fixing it
Ah ok. Good spot
Corrected draft's in the folder 👍
Got it. Accounts are fine now. Going to bed early, marking is brutal
hut heater still working? need to know before the 4th, a few of us might be cold
